description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, an Android activity responsible for displaying detailed information about media content, including metadata, description, and system date/time. It inflates a layout, populates UI components with intent extras, and formats date/time for display.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information including metadata, description, and system date/time.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets content view, and populates system date/time and content data.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Formats and displays current system date and time in designated TextView components.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI components with content metadata from intent extras or default values.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an Intent for launching ContentInfoActivity with specified content data.
